Name: Pride Weapons
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]Inspired by Foxflight Studio's lovely [url=https://foxflightstudios.tumblr.com/tagged/orientation%20armory]LGBT Armory [/url]series, Pride Weapons adds 11 new weapons themed around pride flags! To acquire them, you'll need to follow the rainbow and find a secret cave with 10 crystals, each one containing a custom bundle matching the flag's colours. The weapons have several custom features - as long as you've got one held in your hand, you'll receive a buff to your defense, immunity, and max stamina, swinging them about will shoot coloured projectiles at your enemies, and if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39656]Framework for Emote Mods[/url] installed, equipping a pride weapon will also create a heart emote! All of the weapons can also be renamed via the config menu so that you can give your weapon a suitably cool and unique name, for that fantasy hero feel.[/size]

[size=3]Along with the weapons, you'll also be able to receive as rewards crystal decor themed around the same flags, which can be used to decorate your home, farm, or really anywhere you like. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] installed though, they'll also have a secret extra function - right-click on them to activate a short additional buff![/size]

[size=3]Both the weapons and crystals can optionally be bought from the shop for a fairly high price if you don't feel like (or have compatibility issues with) completing the bundles. Crystals can be bought from Oasis, while weapons can be bought from the Adventurer's Guild, and if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20099]Pride in the Valley[/url] installed, Emily, Sandy, Marlon and Gil will also have new stalls at the summer Pride festivities selling them at a discount.[/size]

[size=5][b]INSTALLATION & DEPENDENCIES[/b][/size]
[size=3]Pride Weapons requires the following framework:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff[/url][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]The following frameworks are also recommended for additional content:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url] - Required for custom bundles. If Unlockable Bundles is not installed, weapons & crystals can only be bought.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39656]Framework for Emote Mods[/url] - Required for custom emote-on-equip feature[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] - Required for crystal buffs[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]To install, make sure that all necessary frameworks are installed, then simply download the zip, extract it, and move the "Pride Weapons" folder into your Mods folder.[/size]

[size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Pride Weapons has special crossover content with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20099]Pride in the Valley[/url] - if PitV is installed, then Sandy and Emily will also attend the Pride festival on Summer 15 to sell the Pride Weapons crystals and Marlon and Gil will attend on Summer 17 to sell the pride weapons (both at a cheaper price than usual), along with several new lines of dialogue.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Pride Weapons is untested with any mods that change the Cindersap Forest map, including SVE. Its bundle entrance may or may not work with SVE, and if it does not, I will not add compatibility. Comments requesting SVE compatibility will be deleted.[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]For other non-SVE mods, Pride Weapons's map edit is in a fairly distant location that's normally inaccessible, so it's unlikely to have compat issues unless the other mod makes major changes to the whole forest map. Requests for compat with other mods will be considered but not guaranteed.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]If you are having compatibility issues with the bundle entrance, you can disable bundles in the config and buy the weapons instead.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Pride Weapons has the following config options:[/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]"Enable Shops"[/b] - "True", "False", or "Pride Festival Only". This option enables or disables weapons & crystals being sold at shops, with "Pride Festival Only" requiring Pride in the Valley.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]"Enable Bundles"[/b] - "True", "False". This option enables or disables the custom bundle content.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]"Weapon Strength"[/b] - "Weak", "Average", "Strong". This option configures how strong the pride weapons are. The default option, "Average" is roughly similar strength to the lava katana, while "Weak" is 0.5x weaker and "Strong" is 1.5x stronger.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]"Rename [Weapon]" [/b]- Allows renaming each of the weapons to have a custom name.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]TRANSLATIONS & NOTES[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]People are welcome to upload translations of Pride Weapons as long as no AI is used in the process and only the translated i18n file is uploaded.[/size][/color]

[size=3]I have no plans to add additional pride flags or content to this mod. If you would like to create an add-on for additional pride weapons, you may do so and may use my code as long as I am credited appropriately, no AI is used in the process, and my mod is a dependency for yours.[/size]
